data.title: 伊卡洛斯 · 晨窗柔光里的羽翼轻靠
data.description: 柔和的朝霞刚刚爬上榻榻米被褥，伊卡洛斯屈膝侧坐在柔软的棉被间，怀里抱住一只圆润的素白枕头。轻纱抹胸裙在晨光下如云絮般柔软，双翼乖巧地半拢在身后，她微微歪头，用轻柔低缓的声音道出一句早安。
data.location: 朝霞微暖的和式卧房棉被间
data.action: 屈膝坐在棉被间轻抱白枕，歪头柔声道早安
data.lighting: 淡金朝霞穿过白帘洒满棉被与羽梢
data.camera: 平视中近景，柔焦前景突出亲近感与清晨温度
data.mood: 纯真、温柔、毫无保留的信赖
data.promptProse: Seated among soft morning-lit blankets on the futon, Ikaros hugs a white pillow lightly against her chest and tilts her head with a quiet good-morning gaze. Warm sunrise light traces the delicate feathered micro-trim of her strapless white silk dress and softens the pale pink sheen of her folded wings.
data.animaCaption: Seated on the sunlit futon hugging a white pillow, she tilts her head softly toward the viewer.
data.nsfwProse: The sheer white silk georgette bodice fits closely over her chest while the pillow presses gently against the soft fabric.
